units.source_text: 一过下午六点半，天就开始擦黑。

en.t: As soon as it was past half past six in the evening, the sky began to grow dark.
I waited for the bell of early summer.

units.source_text: 一到八点，中门左侧的黄钟调①的钟就敲响了初更的十八响，

en.t: At eight o'clock, the bell in the huangzhong mode on the left side of the middle gate rang out the eighteen strokes of the first watch,

units.source_text: 音色高亢而明澄，留下了悠扬的余韵。

en.t: its tone was high and clear, leaving a long, resonant aftersound.
